battle.name: 大非川之戰
battle.brief: 咸亨元年九月，高宗以薛仁貴為瓜州道行軍大總管，率十萬眾西救安西四鎮，進至天山北麓大非川，遭吐蕃論悉諾大軍據險邀擊，攻竟日不克，士卒死者什七八，退保待援，全軍還朝。卡面這件埃及長矛並非唐蕃制式裝備，而是同一技術的另一端：銅或青銅矛頭綁木杆、以刺為主，兩軍近戰主力恰是這類步戰長矛。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 咸亨元年 (670) 九月，大非川之戰是唐王朝與吐蕃王朝在天山北麓的一次正面決戰，背景是吐蕃攻陷唐的安西四鎮。唐一方是關內宿衞軍與天山諸蕃、鐵勒部落的聯軍，最高指揮由高宗任命薛仁貴為瓜州道行軍大總管節制，兵源以京師宿衞、隴右、朔方調發的府兵與募兵為主，另有庭州、伊州等邊州守軍與蕃兵配合，總部設於瓜州至烏海一線，補給依賴長安經涼州、瓜州西運。唐在西域的經營由安西都護府統轄，府兵分駐龜茲、于闐、焉耆、疏勒四鎮，另有庭州與伊州分處天山南北，天山以北的游騎與斥候是最前線的耳目。吐蕃一方是高原帝國，贊普松贊干布居中坐鎮，野戰指揮交給大論一系的論悉諾與其弟論弓仁；前線部隊以自青海方向南下的蕃兵為主，步兵結陣而進，騎兵擔任迂迴、追擊與斷糧，後方以高原與青海的牧業及屯田供糧，兵源則包含吐谷渾歸附的部眾與新附西域城邦的民兵。兩軍的戰術傳統幾乎相反：唐軍以弩、鎧、馬槊立體作戰，重裝與投射火器為骨幹；吐蕃則以步騎混合、居高射擊與地形取勝。
countriesEn: The Battle of Dafeichuan, fought in the ninth month of Xianheng 1 (670), was a set-piece clash between the Tang dynasty and the Tibetan empire on the northern slopes of the Tian Shan, fought in the aftermath of the Tibetans' capture of the Tang's four Anxi garrisons. On the Tang side stood a coalition of the imperial guard and regional troops drawn from the capital, Longyou and Shuofang, together with the garrisons and tribal auxiliaries of the frontier prefectures Tingzhou and Yizhou and the Iron Tiele tribe. Supreme command was given by Emperor Gaozong to Xue Rengui as Commander-in-Chief of the March to Guazhou, with the Tang headquarters line running from Guazhou to Wuhai and the supply line running west from Chang'an through Liangzhou and Guazhou. The Tang presence in the Central Asian regions was administered from the Protectorate General to Pacify the West, whose garrisons were stationed at Qiuci, Khotan, Karashahr and Kashgar, with Tingzhou and Yizhou covering the passes north and south of the Tian Shan; the mounted patrols and scouts north of the Tian Shan were the eyes and ears of the far front. Tibet on the other side was a highland empire ruled from Lhasa by the Songtsen Gampo, who delegated field command to the great minister Lunzhi Nuo and his brother Lun Gonggren. The field army was drawn mainly from Tibetan troops descending from the Qinghai plateau, with infantry advancing in formation and cavalry tasked with turning the flanks, pursuit and cutting the enemy's supply; the rear was supplied by the herds and farmland of the plateau and of Qinghai, and the manpower was swelled by the Tuyuhun people who had come over and by the militia of the oasis states newly absorbed. The two armies fought by almost opposite traditions: the Tang fought in depth with crossbows, armour and cavalry lances, with heavy equipment and missile fire as the backbone, while the Tibetans won with combined infantry and horse, fire from the heights and the use of terrain.
people: 這場戰役的兩端各有一個決定勝負的名字。唐一方是薛仁貴 (薛禮)，時任瓜州道行軍大總管，出身寒微而以驍勇聞於軍中，早年在安市城之役 (640) 破高句麗軍陣、斬將衝鋒，因功擢升；此役他奉詔率師西進，進軍至烏海時先破吐蕃前哨騎兵，一度追擊至河口，形勢一度順利，卻在得知論悉諾大軍已先據大非川險要之後陷入苦戰，一日之中屢攻不克，士卒死傷大半，最後與契苾何力會合，奉詔全軍而還，因而被貶責、削奪官職封邑，其後才重新起復。吐蕃一方的主帥是大論論悉諾，其弟論弓仁副之；論氏是吐蕃權力核心中的世襲大論家族，論悉諾以銳進敢戰聞名，此役率軍自青海南下，直趨安西四鎮，又據大非川以逸待勞，穩住戰局。贊普松贊干布未親臨前線，但所有部署出自其意志；同年他迎娶尼泊爾尺牘珠顏之女，在東南方以婚盟鞏固新取得的立足點。另一端，吐谷渾末代君主慕容弘徽在戰前已為吐蕃所擒，成為吐蕃進取西域的樣板。
peopleEn: Each side of this battle had one name that decided its outcome. On the Tang side was Xue Rengui (Xue Li), then Commander-in-Chief of the March to Guazhou, a man of humble origin who had made his name in the army on his boldness; early in his career he broke the Goguryeo line at the siege of Anshi city (640) and was promoted for his service there. In this campaign he was ordered to lead the relief army west, defeated the Tibetan vanguard horse at Wuhai on the way in and pursued it as far as Hekou, and for a while the operation went well; but once it was known that Lunzhi Nuo's army had already seized the heights of Dafeichuan, the fighting turned into a grinding slog, the assault failing through the whole day and the army losing the greater part of its strength. He finally joined forces with Qiebi Heli, withdrew home on imperial orders, and was accordingly demoted and stripped of rank and fief, only to be restored later. On the Tibetan side the commander was the great minister Lunzhi Nuo, with his brother Lun Gonggren as his lieutenant; the Lunya clan was one of the hereditary great-minister houses at the heart of Tibetan power, and Lunzhi Nuo was famous for aggressive forward command. In this campaign he marched south from Qinghai straight at the four Anxi garrisons and then held the position at Dafeichuan, letting the exhausted Tang army come to him. The Songtsen Gampo did not take the field in person, but every disposition of the campaign came out of his will; in the same year he took as his wife the daughter of the Nepalese king and consolidated his new foothold to the southeast. On the other flank, the last ruler of the Tuyuhun, Murong Honghui, had already been taken by the Tibetans before the battle, and served as their model for the advance into the Western Regions.
kits: 卡面這件埃及長矛不是唐、吐蕃任何一方的制式裝備，它屬於早王朝時期的埃及，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上，埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地；把它放進大非川，只能作兵種譜系的對照：兩軍在河谷平原上最後貼身互搏的近戰主力，正是這類以刺為主、配盾成列的步戰長矛。唐軍這邊可見的裝備有明光鎧與具裝馬鎧、橫刀與佩刀、馬槊與長矛、臂弩與床弩 (弩機已成為唐軍最主要的投射火器)，並有大量標槍與弓箭；遠征兵只攜帶有限口糧與隨軍輜重，沒有足以維持十萬人曠日持久作戰的輜重隊伍。吐蕃步兵以長矛與刀盾為主，弓矢數量驚人，另有投槍與短刀，騎兵多披皮甲或札甲，重騎使用長槊；其營帳、氈氈與牛馬馱運構成高原式的後勤，糧食主要取自青海牧區與沿途屯田。攻城器械方面，唐軍編制中有巢車、雲梯與撞車，但大非川是野戰，這些器械並未派上用場；真正決定勝負的裝備其實是糧草，吐蕃可以就近取用青海與高原的資源，唐軍卻要自長安西運千里，一役崩潰很大程度上是糧道被斷的結果。與此同時，安西四鎮的城垣與城頭守備 (長矛手、床弩) 本可成為收復失地的依據，但它們在戰役開始前已淪陷。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card face is not the standard issue of either the Tang or the Tibetans. It belongs to early-dynasty Egypt, a copper or bronze head bound to a wooden shaft, and the Egyptians used it to hold city walls and later to recover lost ground. Placed in Dafeichuan it can only serve as a comparison within a family of arms: the close-combat core of both armies in the end, when they grappled with each other on the valley floor, was exactly this kind of thrusting foot-soldier spear carried in ordered line behind shields. On the Tang side the visible equipment includes the Mingguang armour and the caparisoned horse armour, the hengdao and peidao sabres, the mashao cavalry lance and the long spear, the arm crossbow and the bed crossbow (the crossbow had already become the main missile weapon of the Tang army), together with large quantities of javelins and arrows. The marching army carried only limited rations and regimental baggage and had no baggage train capable of sustaining ten thousand men in the field for many days. Tibetan infantry fought with spear, sword and shield, with remarkable numbers of bows and arrows, and carried javelins and short swords; the horse wore hide or lamellar armour, and the heavy horse used the long lance. Their tents, felts and pack animals formed a plateau-style logistic system, and food came mainly from the pastures of Qinghai and from farms along the route. As for siege equipment, the Tang order of battle included the nest cart, the scaling ladder and the ram, but Dafeichuan was a field battle and none of it came into play. The equipment that in truth decided the issue was food: the Tibetans could draw on the resources of Qinghai and the plateau close at hand, while the Tang had to haul theirs a thousand li from Chang'an, and the collapse of the Tang army was in large measure the result of its supply line being cut. At the same time, the walls of the four Anxi garrisons and their garrison equipment (spearmen and bed crossbows on the ramparts) could have served as the basis for recovering the lost ground, but they had already fallen before the campaign began.
tactics: 唐軍的戰術程序是典型的唐式遠征：先以先鋒騎兵與斥候清路，再以步騎分隊推進，宿營結壘，築塹自守，節制在進退之間。薛仁貴自瓜州出發，越過河源段的黃河，取烏海，破前哨，追至河口；吐蕃沒有正面硬撼主力，而是以論悉諾所部先據大非川兩側高地與隘口，居高臨下以弓矢射擊，唐軍仰攻而不得。一日攻擊不克，士卒疲於仰射，隊形由方陣散為雜亂，屢次整頓再攻，箭雨與投槍持續消耗兵力，終至不支。吐蕃真正的殺手不在正面，而在斷糧：蕃騎不斷插入唐軍與後方之間，切斷由瓜州方向運來的糧車，又在退路上不斷糾纏追擊，逼唐軍在缺水、缺草、氣候轉冷的九月拖著傷兵回程。唐軍退保大非川、掘塹固守，等待援軍，契苾何力率鐵勒部落兵來援會合，但雙方都無把握再攻，最後奉詔全軍退回。慘敗之後的轉折來自戰術反思：唐廷放棄正面強攻的舊法，改為讓吐蕃深入再切斷其糧道，裴行儉於上元年間收復疏勒、于闐的戰役正是這個思路的實踐，吐蕃因後勤撐不住而退出，逐步丟棄所占的安西四鎮。
tacticsEn: The Tang procedure was that of a textbook Tang expedition: cavalry vanguard and scouts to clear the road, then infantry and horse advancing in separate columns, camping in closed camp by night, entrenching and holding the position, advance and withdrawal carefully controlled. Xue Rengui set out from Guazhou, crossed the upper Yellow River, took Wuhai, broke the vanguard and pursued to Hekou. The Tibetans did not try to hold the line head-on; Lunzhi Nuo's men had already seized the heights and defiles on both sides of Dafeichuan, shooting down with bow and arrow while the Tang assaulted from below and could not close. When the day of assault brought no success, the soldiers were exhausted by fire from above, the formation dissolved from squares into a loose crowd, repeated attempts were made to reform and attack again, and arrow fall and javelin fire kept wearing the army down until it could go no further. The real killer was not the front but the cutting of supply: Tibetan horse kept working between the Tang army and its rear, cutting the grain convoy coming from Guazhou, and harried the retreating column all along the line of march, driving a beaten army in September, short of water and fodder and with the cold coming on, to drag its wounded home. The Tang dug in at Dafeichuan and waited for relief, and Qiebi Heli arrived with the horse of the Iron Tiele tribe; but neither side had the confidence to attack again, and the whole army was withdrawn on imperial orders. The turning point after the disaster came out of a rethink of method: the court gave up the old habit of frontal assault and switched to letting the Tibetans march deep and then cutting their supply, and the campaigns by which Pei Xingjian recovered Khotan and Kashgar in the Shangyuan years were the practice of that idea, the Tibetans withdrawing as their logistic system could no longer bear the strain and giving up the four Anxi garrisons one by one.
data: 可查的數字都出自唐修《舊唐書》《新唐書》與《資治通鑑》，彼此略有出入，應作量級看待。唐軍方面：薛仁貴所部一般記為十萬眾，戰敗後記載士卒死者什七八，即死傷達六至七成；援軍為契苾何力所領鐵勒部落兵，數記十餘萬。吐蕃方面：論悉諾所領大軍，《資治通鑑》記為二十萬，《新唐書》則稱四十萬，兩說並存而都可能有所誇大，比較穩妥的推斷是吐蕃在青海與西域方向可投入十萬以上兵力。時間線：龍朔三年 (663) 吐蕃攻破吐谷渾，咸亨元年 (670) 七月前後吐蕃攻陷西域諸城與安西四鎮，九月薛仁貴出師，十月至十一月全軍退回，戰役歷時不足兩月。距離方面，自瓜州經烏海至大非川行軍數千里，越過天山北麓的多道山口與河谷。還有幾個可用的年序座標：貞觀十五年 (641) 文成公主入蕃，657 年唐平西突厥，663 年吐谷渾國破，668 年遼東都護府廢而唐朝注意力轉向東北，670 年大非川敗，675 年劉仁軌收復龜茲，676 年裴行儉任安西大都護、陸續收復疏勒、于闐等地，四鎮自失陷至復置之間約空窗六年。
dataEn: Every figure that can be checked comes from the Tang histories Old and New Book of Tang and the Comprehensive Mirror, and they differ slightly from one another, so they should be read as orders of magnitude. On the Tang side: Xue Rengui's force is generally recorded as one hundred thousand men, and after the defeat it is recorded that the soldiers who died numbered seven in ten, that is, losses of sixty to seventy per cent; the relief force was the horse of the Iron Tiele tribe led by Qiebi Heli, recorded at more than one hundred thousand. On the Tibetan side: the army under Lunzhi Nuo is recorded as two hundred thousand by the Comprehensive Mirror, while the New Book of Tang gives four hundred thousand; both accounts stand side by side and both may exaggerate, and the safer inference is that the Tibetans could put more than one hundred thousand men into the Qinghai and Central Asian theatre. The timeline: in 663, the third year of Longshuo, the Tibetans broke the Tuyuhun; around the seventh month of Xianheng 1 (670) they overran the oasis cities and the four Anxi garrisons; in the ninth month Xue Rengui took the field; between the tenth and eleventh months the whole army was back, so the campaign lasted under two months. As to distance: the march from Guazhou by way of Wuhai to Dafeichuan ran a thousand li and more, crossing several passes and valleys on the northern slopes of the Tian Shan. Several other chronological markers are useful: 641, Princess Wencheng entered Tibet; 657, the Tang destroyed the Western Turks; 663, the Tuyuhun state fell; 668, the Protectorate General to Pacify Liaodong was abolished and Tang attention turned to the north-east; 670, Dafeichuan was lost; 675, Liu Renji recovered Qiuci; 676, Pei Xingjian became Protector General to Pacify the West and recovered Khotan and Kashgar among other places. Between the fall of the four garrisons and their restoration there was a gap of roughly six years.
cause: 起因是唐、吐蕃在中亞與青藏高原的結構性對撞。唐滅高昌、設安西四鎮之後，把塔里木盆地變成前沿，用以隔斷吐蕃與西突厥殘部、穩定西域諸國，並保持通往波斯、大食的使節與商隊通道；同時唐朝仍以和親與冊封維持與吐蕃的關係。可是 645 年以來的高句麗戰爭與 668 年遼東都護府的裁撤，使唐朝把重心壓在東北，西部邊防空虛，正給了吐蕃可乘之機。670 年前，吐蕃趁唐朝注意力在東北之際先滅吐谷渾、打通青海通道，再攻塔里木盆地的安西四鎮，把唐蕃之間原有的緩衝地帶完全抽走。直接導火線是四鎮淪陷的消息傳到長安，高宗倉促任命薛仁貴出師，而朝廷對吐蕃的兵數、意圖與地理皆無準確掌握，加上遠征糧秣不足、士卒對天山地形生疏、蕃軍反佔先機，於是釀成這場慘敗。
causeEn: The cause was a structural collision between the Tang and the Tibetans in Central Asia and on the Tibetan plateau. After destroying Gaochang and raising the four Anxi garrisons, the Tang turned the Tarim basin into a forward position, using it to separate the Tibetans from the remnants of the Western Turks, to hold the oasis states steady, and to keep the road of envoys and caravans open toward Persia and the Arab empire, while continuing to manage relations with Tibet by marriage alliance and investiture. But the Goguryeo war from 645 onward and the abolition of the Liaodong protectorate in 668 pulled the Tang's weight towards the north-east and left the western frontier hollow, and that was the opening the Tibetans needed. Before 670 the Tibetans took advantage of the Tang's distraction in the north-east, first destroying the Tuyuhun to open the Qinghai route, then striking the four Anxi garrisons in the Tarim basin and completely removing the buffer zone that had separated the two empires. The immediate spark was the news of the fallen garrisons reaching Chang'an: Gaozong appointed Xue Rengui in haste, with no accurate knowledge of the enemy's numbers, intentions or geography, and with the marching army short of food and unfamiliar with the ground north of the Tian Shan while the Tibetans held the favourable position. So the disaster was made.
impact: 大非川之戰是唐蕃力量對比的一次斷裂點。戰前唐朝在西域的存在是主動推進的：安西四鎮已據有數年，可由龜茲、于闐前線屏障中亞，唐朝的使節曾經到達波斯與大食。戰後塔里木盆地落入吐蕃手中，唐朝在中亞的通道被切斷，西域諸城重新陷入混戰，安西都護府名存實亡，直到 676 年前後才重新運作。吐蕃則迎來贊普時期的極盛，東面得以進逼青海與河西，取得從西藏到塔里木的完整高原通道，由區域政權升為足以正面挑戰大唐的強權。戰略層面的影響更長久：裴行儉收復西域所用的斷其糧道、不與決戰之法，後來成為唐朝對吐蕃長期消耗戰的基本方針；763 年吐蕃兵入長安、歷經近百年的拉鋸，最終在 842 年崩解，這段拉鋸的開端，正是 670 年之後唐朝放棄塔里木所造成的邊防結構失衡。同期吐蕃與南亞的聯絡反而更緊密，松贊干布在670年迎娶尼泊爾王女，674年遣使赴天竺求法取經，高原與南亞的往來為西域通道關閉後的又一個亮點。
impactEn: Dafeichuan was a break in the balance of strength between the two states. Before the battle the Tang presence in the West was advancing on its own initiative: the four Anxi garrisons had been held for several years, the forward bases at Qiuci and Khotan screened Central Asia, and Tang envoys had reached Persia and the Arab empire. After the battle the Tarim basin fell to the Tibetans, the Tang corridor into Central Asia was cut, the oasis cities sank back into general disorder, and the Protectorate General to Pacify the West existed in name only until it began to work again around 676. Tibet, for its part, reached the height of the Songtsen Gampo's reign: able to press against Qinghai and Hexi in the east, holding a continuous plateau road from Tibet to the Tarim, and raised from a regional power to a strength able to challenge the Great Tang face to face. The strategic consequences lasted even longer. The method Pei Xingjian used to recover the Western Regions, cutting the enemy's supply rather than offering battle, became the basic doctrine of the long Tang war of attrition against Tibet. When Tibetan troops entered Chang'an in 763 and the two powers ground against each other for close to a century before the Tibetan empire broke up in 842, the beginning of that grind lay in the structural imbalance of the frontier created by the Tang's abandonment of the Tarim after 670. At the same time Tibet's links with South Asia grew tighter instead: the Songtsen Gampo took a Nepalese princess as his wife in 670 and sent an embassy to India to seek scriptures, so that even with the western route shut, the plateau's exchange with South Asia became another point of light in the period.
result: 結果是唐軍大敗。薛仁貴攻大非川不克，士卒死者什七八，唐軍退保河谷固守，最後與契苾何力的援兵合軍而還，薛仁貴因此被貶官削邑；吐蕃則趁勢控制青海與安西四鎮，取得對塔里木盆地的實際統治。直到 675 至 676 年，劉仁軌、裴行儉先後以斷糧之法收復疏勒、于闐等地，四鎮才重新歸唐，但此後河西與西域的攻防從未真正穩定，751 年怛羅斯之役後唐在西域的處境再度惡化。對這一役本身而言，史籍記載有限，兵力數字諸說並存，唯一沒有爭議的是結果：天山北麓那場午後的攻勢之中，十萬唐軍被箭雨與斷糧擊潰，唐朝在西域的攻勢就此改為守勢，直到裴行儉用另一套方法把它扭轉過來。
resultEn: The outcome was a crushing Tang defeat. Xue Rengui's assault on Dafeichuan did not take, the soldiers who died numbered seven in ten, the Tang army fell back to hold in the valley, and finally joined the relieving horse of Qiebi Heli and withdrew home; Xue Rengui was accordingly demoted and stripped of his fief. The Tibetans, for their part, took control of Qinghai and of the four Anxi garrisons and gained practical mastery of the Tarim basin. Only in 675 and 676 did Liu Renji and Pei Xingjian recover Khotan, Kashgar and the other cities by cutting the enemy's supply, and the four garrisons returned to the Tang; even then the fighting over Hexi and the Western Regions never settled, and after the Battle of Talas in 751 the Tang position in the west deteriorated once more. For the battle itself the records are thin, the numbers of troops vary from source to source, and the one thing beyond dispute is the result: in that afternoon's assault on the northern slopes of the Tian Shan, one hundred thousand Tang soldiers were broken by arrow fall and a severed supply line, the Tang offensive in the Western Regions turned into a defensive posture, and it took Pei Xingjian and a different set of methods to reverse it.
